(1) Receivers were read through Devito's interpolation of a staggered field, which averages neighbors (1/4, 1/2, 1/4): at the first vz level it mixed in the zero above the surface (factor 0.75). Fixed in a8_elastic3d.simulate: samples are read by index. (2) The side margins were sized to the wall, but a grazing Rayleigh wave is reflected from the sponge's inner edge (9-45% of the direct wave in the archived traces, inside the windows at 3000 and 3600 m). Fixed in surface_setup: margins to the inner edge. Grid of attempt 1: 461x221x102. The gate, its ranges, frequencies, windows and tolerances are unchanged.
